_note: Keyed by hand from the page images: every numbered section heading in the body (the table of contents' entries), with its level and the PDF page (1 = the file's first page) where it starts, and a few tables, data rows only. A table's first cell is its row label as printed; footnote markers are left out. Born-digital numbers were also checked against the text layer. For each table, 'ask' is how a pipeline is asked for it and 'find' is the text the Docling-then-VLM pipeline looks for to find its pages. The three documents added for issue #130 have no heading numbers. Their headings are the table of contents' entries, with the level its indentation gives and the page the heading is printed on in the body (the Lewis County contents is one page early for five departments, after blank pages). A table may be only part of a longer one, named in its 'ask'.
